{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Verify the premise that assay_batch does not affect biomarker_baseline
# Filter out sentinel values
valid_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Check: are there any non-sentinel values in both batches?
print(f'Number of valid (non -999) rows in batch A: {len(valid_df[valid_df["assay_batch"] == "A"])}')
print(f'Number of valid (non -999) rows in batch B: {len(valid_df[valid_df["assay_batch"] == "B"])}')

# Compute mean baseline by assay_batch
mean_by_batch = valid_df.groupby('assay_batch')['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print('\nMean biomarker_baseline by assay_batch (valid data):')
print(mean_by_batch)

# Compute standard deviation by batch
std_by_batch = valid_df.groupby('assay_batch')['biomarker_baseline'].std()
print('\nStandard deviation by assay_batch (valid data):')
print(std_by_batch)

# Compute difference in means
mean_diff = abs(mean_by_batch['A'] - mean_by_batch['B'])
print(f'\nDifference in means: {mean_diff:.4f} ng/mL')"}
